description: Design variations of one email of a sequence: alternative versions to compare before choosing one, like the Emails view of the sequence editor. They never change the email until use_sequence_email_variation. Lists the email's variations oldest first with status (generating, ready, failed), label (V1, V2, ...), name, summary, blocks, emailTheme and fontFamily (its own look, or null for the email's), and inUse (the email has exactly this content). In MCP Apps clients it shows them side by side, rendered, with buttons to use one. Poll it after generate_sequence_email_variations until none is generating; one still generating after 10 minutes is reported as failed. render_email with sequenceId, nodeId and variationId renders one.
